PART_schema.walls: 'closed' (render_part.walls_png frame) | 'none' | {'open': [[side, t0, t1], ...]} side in top/bottom/left/right, t in tiles along that side (railgun canos: top [1.0, 2.0] and bottom [1.0, 2.0])

PART_schema.layers: list of {name, fn, game_layer, rect [x, y, w, h] tiles (top-left origin, +y down), normals bool, opaque bool, per_situation bool, levels N | frames N | variants [..], file pattern, emission_only bool, islands bool, interval s, pil bool}

layered.model_functions: fn(M, T, **kw) with kw = level (1..N) | phase (frame/F) | variant (str) | sit (str); coordinates centred on the PART, 1 unit = 1 tile, +Y = part front (top of image) like the factory kind
